static_review_findings: Each stage is planned from a newly saved actual endpoint and checked against the current simulation time.
Only entry, center, insert are accepted in this order; each accepted result provides one stage, not subsequent permission.
Complete original wrist quaternion is retained, declared source time and finite stage data are checked, and center is exactly the configured XY move at constant height.
Actual endpoint XY displacement for every stage is included in the 30 mm individual / 50 mm cumulative budget; helper before/after values are cross-checked.
Native full-teddy-to-true-palm/fingers height guard begins before low centering and remains active every step through the final insertion endpoint.
Same ContactGuard object/baseline remains active through release, withdrawal and final settle; only the right two-sided holding lower bound stops at release.
Left designated material proximity and soft-contact holding evidence, soft-body finite/J/strain/table tests remain active.
Script sequence completion alone is not successful containment; unchanged frozen validator must independently pass final all-bear containment and penetration checks.
known_scope_limits: Planning uses observed frozen bear geometry; native contact determines subsequent cloth/soft-body deformation.
The 1 percent perimeter allowance and 5 mm height/robot margins are declared engineering trial policies, not experimental material or hardware calibration.
Native height guard samples completed integration states and does not separately certify between-step motion.
Recorded IPC wrench does not include native Genesis rigid contact forces.
No full13 outcome is claimed in this startup review.
